description: EITI Complete Summary Data Table is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Economics and prices, Policies and plans", published or maintained by Natural Resource Governance Institute . The data is published using the Summary Data Template, Version 1.1 as of 05 March 2015. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 2 files in HTML. The portal files it under Economics and prices, Policies and plans. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
